messages.subject: Firma Scores are all NA
parts:
Hi all
Thanks everybody who answers questions.
I have followed the firma vignette so far to the points no error
after

firma <- FirmaModel(plmTr)
fit(firma, verbose=verbose)
fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)

or

firma <- FirmaModel(plmEx)
fit(firma, verbose=verbose)
fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)

I simply followed the instruction on the vignette "You can extract the
firma scores in the same way as the transcript/exon estimates with
extractDataFrame() or readUnits() applied to fs." (can be found at the
end of the document at http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis).

Here are my questions:
1) when I look at the fs they are all "NA". Where did I make mistake?
Only thing I can tell is that I have not input the phenotype of the
samples so far. Does the firma score need to have the phenotype info
in place before the firma scores can be calculated?
2) I want to further do testing using limma on the firma scores on
both transcript/gene level and probeset/exon level. One of the thread
between Mark and Frank indicates the FIRMA only calculate the scores
on probeset/exon level. Is that right? if so that the

firma <- FirmaModel(plmEx)
fit(firma, verbose=verbose)
fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)

do? Note the plmEx not the plmTr here.

Thank you again. Appreciate your attention and help.
-Wenhong

messages.subject: Re: Firma Scores are all NA
parts:
I have solved the question I posted below by following an old thread
by Mark. No "NaN" in the firmascore anymore.The reason is that fit
(plm, verbose=verbose) was left out in the original script

The following script works:

library(aroma.affymetrix)

# setup
verbose <- Arguments$getVerbose(-20, timestamp=TRUE)
chipType <- "HuEx-1_0-st-v2"
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType
(chipType,tags="coreR3,A20071112,EP")
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("My_AML_14samples", cdf=cdf)

# BG adjust + QN
bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs, tag="coreR3")
csBC <- process(bc,verbose=verbose)
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate="pm")
csN <- process(qn, verbose=verbose)

# fit PLM, FIRMA
plm <- ExonRmaPlm(csN, mergeGroups=TRUE)
fit(plm, verbose=verbose)
rs <- calculateResiduals(plm, verbose=verbose)
firma <- FirmaModel(plm)
